description: Elections Commission - Declare that H. G. U. Priyantha as a member of the Kamburupitiya Pradeshiya Sabha
reasoning: This gazette concerns the filling of a vacancy in a local government body (Kamburupitiya Pradeshiya Sabha) due to the death of an elected member, following procedures outlined in the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance. It specifically deals with electoral processes, candidate nominations, and declarations of elected members, which falls under the Elections classification category.
